Every generated and canonical HTML destination
Global navigation, footer, and shared interactive components
Every link, button, form, and disclosure occurrence
Courses, lessons, assessments, credentials, pathways, tools, builds, demos, templates, downloads, monitors, workspace and access claims
Internal and external destinations represented by public controls

excluded.surface: Authenticated records and third-party systems not reachable from the public production estate
excluded.reason: Cannot be truthfully inventoried from public production or repository evidence
excluded.control: Add when credentials and explicit audit authority are available

excluded.surface: Unpublished ideas contained only in private conversation or unmerged branches
excluded.reason: Not a public visitor promise at the frozen baseline
excluded.control: Must enter the ledger before future publication

excluded.surface: Independent factual and legal validation of every substantive sentence
excluded.reason: This baseline inventories promise exposure and delivery state; claim-by-claim authority review is a roadmap tranche
excluded.control: High-stakes claims receive P0 verification disposition

groupingRule: Identical promise or action signatures share one ledger record, but every route occurrence remains enumerated in that record.
materialityRule: Titles, summaries, structured delivery fields, action labels, deliverables, downloads, access/status language, limitations, roadmap statements, and interactive controls are promise-bearing.
freezeRule: A changed denominator, removed occurrence, or new signature fails promise:check until the ledger and freeze manifest are intentionally regenerated and reviewed.
